notes: Five prompts should route to this skill and five are adjacent but out of scope, so both over-triggering and under-triggering are measurable.
One out-of-scope probe is the case the skill's 'When NOT to use this' section names: a formatting-only change with no security-relevant content. Another belongs to terraform-testing.
A probe is correct when the skill fired and was expected to, or did not fire and was not expected to.

prompts.prompt: Add an S3 backend block to this Terraform root so the team stops sharing state over Slack.
The Terraform module takes the API token as a plain variable and echoes it in an output. Clean that up.
Review the IAM role our Terraform pipeline assumes before we let it apply to production.
Our Terraform modules point at a Git repository with no ref. Fix the module sources and the provider constraints.
Write the Terraform for a KMS key and an RDS instance whose master password Terraform never sees.
Run terraform fmt over the repository and fix the indentation in the README's HCL examples.
Add a terraform test file that checks the module's subnet_count variable rejects zero.
Convert this CloudFormation template's parameters section to use SSM parameter types.
Our Ansible role writes AWS credentials into ~/.aws/credentials on the build host. Move them to an instance profile.
Explain the difference between terraform plan and terraform apply -refresh-only. No code changes needed.
